name: one-spinner-to-rule-them-all
description: Replaces the words in Claude Code's working spinner with ominous lines from Tolkien's legendarium

verbs.title: Spinner verbs
verbs.description: Lines to show while Claude works. Typed as one text, separate them with new lines or semicolons; commas stay inside a line.
default: Delving too greedily and too deep
Straying out of thought and time
Wandering far on roads that I will not tell
Twisting it to your own undoing
Bringing ruin, turning hope to despair
Vowing to pursue with vengeance and hatred to the ends of the World
Sowing lies in the hearts of Elves and Men
Coiling around and above all obstacles
Bending all slowly and surely to my will
Weighing as a cloud of Doom
Seeking to have own will by force
Watching with sleepless eyes of flame
Stirring the shadow of Sauron again
Casting down pillars and breaking lamps
Corrupting and enslaving by slow arts of cruelty
Breeding Orcs in envy and mockery of the Elves
Making vast smokes and vapours in the pits of Angband
Sending forth great rivers of flame
Gathering all the remaining Rings of Power
Conceiving evil in lies and creatures of wickedness

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: replace: only these lines. mix: these lines plus Claude Code's own
